//go:build integration

package infrastructure_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/nats-io/nats-server/v2/server"
	cfgviper "github.com/nostosx/servex-contrib/config/viper"
	sxconfig "github.com/nostosx/servex/config"
	"github.com/twmb/franz-go/pkg/kfake"

	"x.dev/s/infrastructure/config"
	"x.dev/s/infrastructure/database/mysql"
	"x.dev/s/infrastructure/database/postgres"
	"x.dev/s/infrastructure/messaging/kafka"
	"x.dev/s/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
)

type values map[string]any

func (v values) Load(ctx context.Context) (map[string]any, error) { return v, ctx.Err() }

func reader(t *testing.T, data values) sxconfig.Reader {
	t.Helper()
	cfg, err := cfgviper.New(t.Context(), []sxconfig.Source{data})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return cfg.Snapshot()
}

type resource interface {
	Name() string
	Start(context.Context) error
	Check(context.Context) error
	Stop(context.Context) error
}

func TestConstructorsRejectMissingReaderAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name string
		new  func(context.Context, sxconfig.Reader) (resource, error)
	}{
		{"mysql", func(ctx context.Context, r sxconfig.Reader) (resource, error) { return mysql.New(ctx, r) }},
		{"postgres", func(ctx context.Context, r sxconfig.Reader) (resource, error) { return postgres.New(ctx, r) }},
		{"kafka", func(ctx context.Context, r sxconfig.Reader) (resource, error) { return kafka.New(ctx, r) }},
		{"nats", func(ctx context.Context, r sxconfig.Reader) (resource, error) { return nats.New(ctx, r) }},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := tc.new(t.Context(), nil); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("nil reader accepted")
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
			cancel()
			if _, err := tc.new(ctx, nil); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := tc.new(t.Context(), reader(t, values{tc.name: values{"timeout": "0s"}})); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid config accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestSQLPoolsAreLazyAndCloseOnStartupFailure(t *testing.T) {
	my, err := mysql.New(t.Context(), reader(t, values{"mysql": values{"dsn": "tcp(127.0.0.1:1)/application"}}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = my.Stop(context.Background()) })
	pg, err := postgres.New(t.Context(), reader(t, values{"postgres": values{"dsn": "postgres://127.0.0.1:1/application?sslmode=disable"}}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = pg.Stop(context.Background()) })
	if my.DB.Stats().OpenConnections != 0 || pg.DB.Stats().OpenConnections != 0 {
		t.Fatal("construction connected")
	}
	if my.DB.Stats().MaxOpenConnections != 20 || pg.DB.Stats().MaxOpenConnections != 20 {
		t.Fatal("pool limit not applied")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	cancel()
	for _, r := range []resource{my, pg} {
		if err := r.Start(ctx); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := r.Check(t.Context()); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("failed startup kept pool open")
		}
		if err := r.Stop(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func TestSQLValidationAndSecretRedaction(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, dsn string }{
		{"mysql", "private-password@tcp(bad"},
		{"postgres", "postgres://user:private-password@%zz/db"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			check := func(data values) error {
				if tc.name == "mysql" {
					_, err := mysql.New(t.Context(), reader(t, data))
					return err
				}
				_, err := postgres.New(t.Context(), reader(t, data))
				return err
			}
			if err := check(values{}); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("empty DSN accepted")
			}
			if err := check(values{tc.name: values{"dsn": tc.dsn}}); err == nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "private-password") {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := check(values{tc.name: values{"dsn": "unused", "max_idle_conns": 21}}); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid pool accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestKafkaLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	cluster, err := kfake.NewCluster(kfake.NumBrokers(2))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(cluster.Close)
	// Env supplies strings, while YAML supplies lists. Both must accept broker addresses.
	r, err := kafka.New(t.Context(), reader(t, values{"kafka": values{"brokers": strings.Join(cluster.ListenAddrs(), ","), "timeout": "2s"}}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = r.Stop(context.Background()) })
	if err := r.Start(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Check(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Stop(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Stop(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Check(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("closed client ready")
	}
}

func TestNATSLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	srv, err := server.NewServer(&server.Options{Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: -1, JetStream: true, StoreDir: t.TempDir(), NoLog: true, NoSigs: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { srv.Shutdown(); srv.WaitForShutdown() })
	go srv.Start()
	if !srv.ReadyForConnections(10 * time.Second) {
		t.Fatal("server not ready")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	r, err := nats.New(ctx, reader(t, values{"nats": values{"url": srv.ClientURL(), "timeout": "2s"}}))
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = r.Stop(context.Background()) })
	if err := r.Start(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Check(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Stop(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Stop(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := r.Check(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("closed connection ready")
	}
}

func TestNestedEnvironmentSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	t.Chdir(t.TempDir())
	t.Setenv("APP_TOKEN", strings.Repeat("a", 32))
	t.Setenv("APP_MYSQL__DSN", "tcp(127.0.0.1:1)/fromenv")
	t.Setenv("APP_MYSQL__MAX_OPEN_CONNS", "12")
	cfg, err := config.Load(t.Context(), "test", nil, io.Discard)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r, err := mysql.New(t.Context(), cfg.Values)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = r.Stop(context.Background()) }()
	if r.DB.Stats().MaxOpenConnections != 12 {
		t.Fatal("nested environment settings were lost")
	}
}
